code:
Query: assignment_group = Network Ops

No index on assignment_group:
  Row 1    -> check it
  Row 2    -> check it
  Row 3    -> check it
  ...
  Row 400,000 -> check it

Every row, checked one at a time.
caption: Without an index, the database has only one option: look at everything.

code:
With an index on assignment_group:

  Jump directly to matching rows
  Skip everything that doesn't match

Like a book's index vs. reading
every page looking for a word.
caption: An index lets the engine find matches directly.

code:
Every insert or update to the table:

  Write the row
  + update Index 1
  + update Index 2
  + update Index 3 ...

More indexes = more work on every write,
used or not.
caption: Indexes speed up reads by slowing down writes.
